title: probe
description: Which TI services of an environment answered; exit 0 when none failed, 1 otherwise.

schema.description: The JSON contract version; fields are only added within it.

access_paths.description: Per access path with endpoints, whether any of them answered.

available.description: False when no endpoint of the path answered: the path is down (for ti-vpn, no TI VPN; for bestandsnetz, none routed), not the services.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case: <service>-<n> for numbered instances (epa-1), the service for a singleton (catalog), idpd-ti / idpd-internet for the IDP, the lowercase ID of Bestandsnetze.xml for a Bestandsnetz (snk).

access.description: How the endpoint is reached: ti-vpn only through a Konnektor's or TI-Gateway's VPN, internet directly, bestandsnetz through the TI VPN into a Bestandsnetz the Konnektor routes when the practice booked it (gematik's Bestandsnetze.xml; not answering is a warning). The catalog's instances are internet.

source.description: builtin, or an instance the service-discovery catalog lists.

status.description: ok: the expected answer; warn: an answer, not the expected one, or no answer from a Bestandsnetz; fail: no answer.

answered.description: The endpoint answered; false for a transport failure (timeout, refused, DNS, TLS), whatever the status.
